name: Continental Brands Real Instant Coffee Auto Barista

description.value:
The RICAB: a wood-look coffee cabinet that brews several cups at once from whatever you put in it, and shows off your Real-Coffee.

Extra working hours of downtime a day: Generic PrePak +1, Good PrePak +2, Fresh Food +3 (Kibble: none). Overdoing it may call for Resist Torture/Drugs checks. Makes WakeUP! when given the ingredients.

Houseware can't be fabricated or haggled over, and only Fixers source it: bought from a catalogue it costs four times as much.

500eb · 1 slot.
